mapper.select: /** com.secta.hcbatch.job.message.mapper.HcMsgMapper.selectMsgTrigList */ SELECT TO_CHAR(A.TRIG_DATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISSFF9') AS TASK_DTM , TO_CHAR(A.TRIG_SEQ) AS TASK_NO , A.ORDER_NO , REPLACE(A.SEND_PHONE, '-', '') AS SEND_PHONE , REPLACE(A.RCV_PHONE, '-', '') AS RCV_PHONE , A.MMS_SUBJ , A.MMS_CTT , A.MMS_IMG_FILE , A.MMS_AT_FILE FROM T_HAPPYCON_MMS A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.TRIG_DATE >= TO_TIMESTAMP( TO_CHAR(TO_TIMESTAMP(#{taskDtm}, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISSFF9') - 3 / 60 / 60 / 24, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') || '.000000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS.FF9') AND A.TRIG_DATE <= TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE - 0 / 24 / 3600, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') || '.000000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS.FF9') AND A.TRIG_SEQ <> TO_NUMBER(#{taskNo}) AND A.SEND_DTM IS NULL AND TRIM(A.MMS_AT_FILE) IS NULL ORDER BY A.TRIG_DATE
mapper.update: /** com.secta.hcbatch.job.message.mapper.HcMsgMapper.updateMsgTrigInfo */ UPDATE T_HAPPYCON_MMS A SET A.SEND_DTM = SYSDATE WHERE A.TRIG_DATE = TO_TIMESTAMP(#{taskDtm}, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISSFF9') AND A.TRIG_SEQ = TO_NUMBER(#{taskNo})
mapper.insert: /** com.secta.hcbatch.job.message.mapper.HcMsgMapper.insertSendMsg */ INSERT INTO EM_TRAN ( TRAN_PR , TRAN_PHONE , TRAN_CALLBACK , TRAN_STATUS , TRAN_DATE , TRAN_MSG , TRAN_TYPE , TRAN_ETC1 , TRAN_ETC4) VALUES ( EM_TRAN_PR.NEXTVAL , #{rcvPhone} , #{sendPhone} , '1' , SYSDATE , ' ' , TO_NUMBER(#{sendType}) , #{orderNo} , TO_NUMBER(#{mmsSeq}))
